name: io.github.layers/mcp
title: Layers MCP
description: Growth endpoint a coding agent calls to plan, render and deliver content for a product.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <session>. Run `layers setup` (or `layers login`) from the repository to issue one; the CLI stores it in the OS credential store.

packageArguments.description: Runs the Layers CLI as the stdio bridge to https://mcp.layers.com/mcp, forwarding every JSON-RPC message with the stored session.
